title: Crossover Chop
briefing: Nimbus Cloud starts in a clean uptrend, then the news turns noisy. Watch the fast and slow averages and decide when crossing signals stop being worth taking.
objective: Moving-average crossovers catch trends but whipsaw in sideways markets.
debrief: The averages lined up during the first two weeks, and a crossover entry rode the trend. From day 16 the market went sideways: the downgrade on day 18, the product event on day 22, the price-war report on day 26 and the bank contract on day 30 sent price back and forth across the averages. Each cross came late and reversed. A disciplined player kept the trend trade, stepped aside once the slow average flattened, and kept the trade count low.
